versions.changelog:
Initial release of the 供应商来料质量专项分析 skill:

- Automates analysis of supplier IQC (Incoming Quality Control) data for enterprises.
- Supports multi-sheet Excel inputs, data cleaning, quality metric calculation, defect distribution, benchmarking, trend analysis, and risk rating.
- Generates dual-format reports (Markdown/HTML) for direct supplier feedback.
- Requires clear user input and field mapping; interactive workflow ensures process traceability.
- Includes usage examples and resource references for rapid onboarding.
